# PR Failure Template

**Version**: 1.0.0 **Usage**: Auto-generated by CI Resolver workflow

---

## Template: Auto-Fix PR

Use this template when automation creates a PR to fix a CI failure.

```markdown
## CI Auto-Fix: {FAILURE_TYPE}

**Generated by**: CI Resolver Bot **Run ID**: {RUN_ID} **Classification**:
{FAILURE_TYPE} (Severity: {SEVERITY})

---

### Summary

{ONE_LINE_SUMMARY}

### Root Cause

{ROOT_CAUSE_DESCRIPTION}

### Changes

{CHANGE_DESCRIPTION}

### Evidence

- **Failed Run**: [{RUN_ID}]({RUN_URL})
- **Logs**: [View artifacts]({ARTIFACT_URL})
- **Classification Rationale**: {CLASSIFICATION_REASON}

### Verification

- [ ] Fix addresses root cause
- [ ] No unintended side effects
- [ ] Tests pass locally
- [ ] Reviewed by human

### Related

- Parent PR: #{PARENT_PR} (if applicable)
- Incident: {INCIDENT_ID} (if applicable)

---

> **Note**: This PR was auto-generated. Human review and approval required
> before merge. See
> [AUTO_RESOLUTION_POLICY.md](docs/ops/AUTO_RESOLUTION_POLICY.md) for details.
```

---

## Template: Revert PR

Use this template when automation creates a revert PR.

```markdown
## Revert: {ORIGINAL_PR_TITLE}

**Generated by**: CI Resolver Bot **Reverts**: #{ORIGINAL_PR_NUMBER} **Reason**:
{FAILURE_TYPE} regression detected

---

### Why Revert?

{REGRESSION_DESCRIPTION}

### Original PR

- **PR**: #{ORIGINAL_PR_NUMBER}
- **Author**: @{ORIGINAL_AUTHOR}
- **Merged**: {MERGE_TIMESTAMP}

### Failure Details

- **Failed Run**: [{RUN_ID}]({RUN_URL})
- **Failed Checks**: {FAILED_CHECKS_LIST}
- **Time to Failure**: {TIME_SINCE_MERGE}

### Impact Assessment

{IMPACT_DESCRIPTION}

### Verification Checklist

- [ ] Revert is complete (all changes from original PR)
- [ ] No partial reverts that could cause inconsistency
- [ ] Original author notified
- [ ] Incident ticket created if P0/P1

---

> **IMPORTANT**: This revert was auto-generated but NOT auto-merged. Human
> review required. See [FORBIDDEN_ACTIONS.md](docs/ops/FORBIDDEN_ACTIONS.md).
```

## Variable Reference

| Variable               | Description            | Example                            |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `{FAILURE_TYPE}`       | Classification type    | `REGRESSION`, `CONFIG`, `FLAKE`    |
| `{SEVERITY}`           | Priority level         | `P0`, `P1`, `P2`, `P3`             |
| `{RUN_ID}`             | GitHub Actions run ID  | `21109615821`                      |
| `{RUN_URL}`            | Full URL to run        | `https://github.com/...`           |
| `{ARTIFACT_URL}`       | URL to saved artifacts | `https://github.com/.../artifacts` |
| `{COMMIT_SHA}`         | Git commit hash        | `abc123def456`                     |
| `{BRANCH_NAME}`        | Branch name            | `feat/my-feature`                  |
| `{WORKFLOW_NAME}`      | Workflow file name     | `ci.yml`                           |
| `{ORIGINAL_PR_NUMBER}` | PR being reverted      | `123`                              |
| `{ORIGINAL_AUTHOR}`    | Author of original PR  | `username`                         |
| `{INCIDENT_ID}`        | Incident tracking ID   | `INC-2026-0118-001`                |

---

## Label Application

Based on failure type, apply these labels:

| Failure Type | Labels                                              |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| FLAKE        | `ci:flake`, `severity:p3`                           |
| REGRESSION   | `ci:regression`, `severity:p1`, `needs-review`      |
| CONFIG       | `ci:config`, `severity:p2`, `ci:auto-fixable`       |
| MIGRATION    | `ci:migration`, `severity:p0`, `ci:manual-required` |
| SECURITY     | `ci:security`, `severity:p0`, `ci:manual-required`  |
| POLICY       | `ci:policy`, `severity:p1`, `needs-review`          |

---
